discoverIntro: Scan configured networks to find OT targets. Results update inventory status on the Inventory page.
discoverNoPermission: You need the View connection targets permission to open OT Discover.
connectNoPermission: You need the View connection targets permission to open OT Connect.
inventoryNoPermission: You need the View connection targets permission to open OT Inventory.
credentialsNoPermission: You need the View connection targets permission to open OT Credentials.
sessionsNoPermission: You need the View connection targets permission to open OT Sessions.
inventoryIntro: Review discovered targets, read status chips, and open Configure for non-secret fields and rotation schedules.
connectIntro: Run Check connectivity (enables Connect) in the status banner before Connect becomes active on new targets. OT sessions carry PDU data — not SSH, RDP, or VNC desktops.
credentialsIntro: Select a target, then rotate a password or request a logged break-glass reveal.
sessionsIntro: Review recorded OT protocol sessions as audit evidence. Open session for the PDU timeline.
statusHelpLive: Live means this target recently answered a discovery probe. This is not an assessment verdict.
statusHelpBlocked: BLOCKED means the last probe could not reach this target. Check reachability, then run discovery again.
statusHelpPartial: Partial means the target is listed but is not Live yet. Run discovery to update status.
oldPasswordEmpty: Leave the old password empty to use the stored password.
protocolChipsIntro: Supported OT protocols and their current connect readiness.
checkConnectivityAria: Check connectivity of all OT targets
inventoryHonesty: Inventory status: {{status}} · {{count}} assets. Connect uses last TCP probe of each dial port (availability only — not a live session proof).
statusLiveDetail: Live means this target recently answered a discovery or protocol probe successfully.
statusLiveNext: Use Connect to open a session, or Configure to edit settings and schedules.
statusBlockedDetail: BLOCKED means the last discovery or protocol probe could not reach this target.
statusBlockedNext: Confirm the host is reachable, then run Discover and retry Connect.
statusPartialDetail: Partial means this target is in inventory but has not fully proved Live on a discovery or protocol probe yet. This is delivery status — not a compliance verdict.
statusPartialNext: Next: run Discover, then use Connect when the target is ready.
partialStatusHelp: Partial means a target is listed but has not fully proved Live on a discovery or protocol probe yet. Hover a Status chip for the next step. Status values describe delivery — they are not a compliance verdict.
discoveryJobsIntro: Enter networks to scan, then run discovery. Results update inventory status. An optional schedule repeats the scan.
scanNetworksHelper: One IPv4 network per line in CIDR form (for example 192.168.10.0/24). This run uses the first network. Leave empty for the configured default.
gridAssetHelp: Display name of the OT inventory target.
gridCommentHelp: Operator use-case note for this target. Hover to read the full text when truncated.
gridProtocolHelp: OT protocol chip for this seat (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3, and so on). Not IT SSH/RDP/VNC.
gridReachabilityHelp: TCP check of the Connect dial port (host:port). Reachable enables the Connect control only — not a live session proof.
gridHostHelp: Network endpoint as host:port for this OT target.
gridStatusHelp: Delivery status from inventory/discovery (Live, Partial, or BLOCKED). Never Met or certified.
gridActionsHelp: Connect opens OT PDU Live. Configure edits non-secret target settings. Select picks a row for break-glass on Credentials.
protocolTip: OT protocol: {{label}}. Connect opens an OT PDU session for this protocol — not an SSH/RDP/VNC canvas.
reachTip: {{dial}} is {{status}}.{{last}} Availability only — not Connect protocol-surface PASS.
connectReadyTitle: Connect / Open OT broker session → OT PDU Live timeline. Availability only until session proves connecting|connected.
connectUnknownTitle: Connect stays off until you run Check connectivity (status banner above). No probe has run for this target yet.
connectCheckingTitle: Connectivity probe in progress… Connect stays off until it finishes.
connectUnreachableTitle: Target dial port was not reachable on the last probe. Run Check connectivity again after fixing the network path.
connectAriaUnknown: Connect disabled — run Check connectivity before connecting to {{name}}
connectAriaUnreachable: Connect disabled — {{name}} is not reachable on {{host}}:{{port}}
wizardIntro: Set up your OT environment: find targets, review them, and enroll them in inventory. Status values are delivery evidence (Live, Partial, or BLOCKED) — not an assessment verdict.
